## Filtering out key words from landing receipts:
```{r Load in the Landings_GoC dataframe}
Landings_GoC<- readRDS(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/fis/v2025/int/juan_carlos/GoC_Landings_2000.present_EMF_created.rds"))
# n = 3716415 obs.
```

```{r Filter out keywords from recorded_taxa_name to get recorded_taxa_name_clean}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keyword list
# ------------------------------------------------------------
keyword_list <- c(
  "S.C.", "S/C", "S",
  "ENTERO", "ENTERA", "IND", "ENT",
  "FRESCO", "FRESCA", "FCA", "FCO", "FC",
  "ECO",
  "CONG", "CONGELADO",
  "VIVO", "VIVA", "VIVAS", "VIVITA",
  "DE CULTIVO", "DE CULTIVO VIVO", "ABASTO RANCHO", "RANCHO",
  "HUEVA DE",
  "FILETE", "FILETE DE", "ECA", "FILETE DE ECO", "DESHUESADA", "CARNE", "CARNE DE",
  "DESCABEZADO", "DES", "DSC", "DESC",  "DESV", "DESVICERADO",
  "CABEZA DE", "BUCHE", "BUCHE DE", "TRIPA DE", "COLAS DE", "MANOS DE", "MANOS", "ANCAS DE", "ANCAS", "ANCA",
  "PIEL DE ECA", "PIEL DE SECA", "PIEL DE", "PIEL",
  "SECO DE", "SECA", "SECA DE", "SECO", "SECO DE",
  "COCINERO", "COCIDO", "COCIDA", "COCIDAS", "ASADO",
  "ALETA", "ALETA ECA DE", "ALETA FCA DE",
  "DE ALTA MAR",
  "CONCHA DE", "CONCHA",
  "POLVO DE",
  "CARNADA", "P/CARNADA",
  "DE AGUA DULCE",
  "MANTO", "MANTO DE", "PULPA DE", "PULPA FRESCA", "PULPO DE", "TENTACULOS DE", "TUBO DE", "TUBO",
  "NO APTO PARA EMPAQUE"
)

# Sort by descending length to match multi-word keywords first
keyword_list <- keyword_list[order(nchar(keyword_list), decreasing = TRUE)]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Escape regex metacharacters
# ------------------------------------------------------------
escape_regex <- function(x) {
  str_replace_all(x, "([.|(){}+*?^$\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")
}

keyword_list_escaped <- escape_regex(keyword_list)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create safe lookaround-based regex
#   This allows punctuation inside keywords (e.g., "S.C.")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
keyword_pattern <- paste0(
  "(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(",
  paste(keyword_list_escaped, collapse = "|"),
  ")(?![A-Za-z0-9])"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Apply the extraction & cleaning
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Landed_Sp_List <- Landings_GoC %>%
  select(recorded_taxa_group = recorded_taxa_group, recorded_taxa_name = species_name) %>% # rename the columns as necessary
  distinct() %>%
  
  mutate(
    keywords = str_extract_all(recorded_taxa_name, keyword_pattern)
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(keywords = lapply(keywords, function(x) { length(x) <- 5; x })) %>%
  unnest_wider(keywords, names_sep = "_") %>%
  
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    recorded_taxa_name_clean =
      if_else(
        recorded_taxa_name %in% c(
          "TIBURON ALETA BLANCA",
          "BERRUGATA ALETA AMARILLA",
          "CORVINA ALETA CORTA",
          "CORVINA ALETA AMARILLA"
        ),
        recorded_taxa_name,
        str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name, keyword_pattern)
      ),
    
  # REMOVE: standalone "Y"s
  recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\bY\\b"),
  
  # REMOVE: standalone "DE"s
  recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\bDE\\b"),
  
  # REMOVE: standalone "P/"s
  recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_remove_all(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\bP/\\b"),

  # CLEAN UP: leftover punctuation such as ". .", ".", commas, and backslashes:
  recorded_taxa_name_clean =
  recorded_taxa_name_clean |>
  str_replace_all("[.,/\\\\]+", " "),   # remove . , / \
  
  # And collapse whitespace with str_squish()
  recorded_taxa_name_clean = str_squish(recorded_taxa_name_clean)
) %>%
ungroup()

Landed_SpKey<- Landed_Sp_List %>% distinct(recorded_taxa_group, recorded_taxa_name_clean)

# EXTRACT: scientific names from parentheses
Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name <- sub(".*\\(([^)]+)\\).*", "\\1", Landed_SpKey$recorded_taxa_name_clean)
# Set NA if original string had no parentheses:
Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name[!grepl("\\(", Landed_SpKey$recorded_taxa_name_clean)] <- NA
# Trim whitespace:
Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name <- trimws(Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name)

# CLARIFY: Make a column that tells the reader whether or not the scientific_name was recorded in the original record:
Landed_SpKey$scientific_name_recorded_T.F <- ifelse(
  !is.na(Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name) & Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name != "",
  1, 0)

# Convert scientific_name to proper binomial capitalization:
capitalize_binomial <- function(x){
  x <- tolower(x)                    # all lowercase
  words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]     # split words
  if(length(words) >= 2){
    words[1] <- paste0(toupper(substring(words[1],1,1)), substring(words[1],2))  # Genus capitalized
    words[2] <- words[2]  # species lowercase
    return(paste(words[1], words[2]))
  } else {
    return(x)
  }
}

Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name <- sapply(Landed_SpKey$recorded_scientific_name, function(x){
  if(!is.na(x)) capitalize_binomial(x) else NA
})


# Make a column for recorded_common_name
Landed_SpKey <- Landed_SpKey %>%
  mutate(
    recorded_common_name = str_trim(
      str_remove(recorded_taxa_name_clean, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)")
    )
  )

# Make recorded_common_name lowercase:
Landed_SpKey <- Landed_SpKey %>%
  mutate(recorded_common_name = tolower(recorded_common_name))

length(unique(Landed_SpKey$recorded_common_name))
length(unique(Landed_SpKey$main_species_group))
# 797 unique names (versus 973 with the less comprehensive keywords_list), 734 common names, over 57 taxanomic groups
```

```{r Prepare to merge}
Mar_SpKey <- Mar_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))
Mar_SpKey_filtered <- Mar_SpKey %>% select(common_name_IHH= common_name, fishery, highest_taxonomic_id, highest_taxonomic_resolution, species, genus, family, order, class, IHH_functional_major_groups_sm)

Hem_SpKey <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  select(common_name_Hem= common_name, species)

Hem_SpKey_filtered<- Hem_SpKey_filtered %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(common_name_Hem) %>%
  mutate(species_num = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey_filtered %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species_num,
    values_from = species,
    names_prefix = "possible_species_"
  )
```

```{r Merge}
merged_df1 <- stringdist_join(
  Landed_SpKey,
  Mar_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_common_name" = "common_name_IHH"),
  method = "jw",          # Jaro-Winkler works well for name matching
  max_dist = 0.10,        # adjust as needed
  distance_col = "dist"   # keep the distance so you can inspect match quality
)

merged_df2 <- left_join(
  Landed_SpKey,
  Mar_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_common_name" = "common_name_IHH")
)

merged_df3 <- left_join(
  merged_df2,
  Hem_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_common_name" = "common_name_Hem")
)

```
